supportClaimEffect: none; native compatibility gate remains open
scope: A locally generated R13 source was projected to an R2000 DXF with a scratch-only bypass of the production legacy layout refusal. A macOS LibreCAD candidate opened it and saved a separate copy at the same DXF version.
observations: The native application opened and displayed the drawing and saved a copied drawing as AC1015 without an omission warning.

Independent readback found the original line geometry and both layout names, with no reported audit errors or fixes. The paper layout no longer has its ACAD_XDICTIONARY link; its dictionary and child XRECORD remain physically present but are no longer linked by that layout. Both layout ACAD_REACTORS groups are absent in the saved file.

A current-head libdxfrw import probe independently retained the original paper layout xdictionary handle 0x33 and both layouts' reactor groups. This isolates neither the consumer save path nor the older codec; an exact-current consumer and codec native reproduction remains required.
limits: This diagnostic source uses a scratch-only guard bypass; it does not establish production DWG export or a general support claim.

The observed loss must be reproduced against the final consumer and codec, traced, fixed and rechecked with preserved source, changed and missing targets, atomic failure and corrected retry as applicable.
Native dictionary cloning, other layout graphs, releases and platforms remain unqualified. No drawing fixture was committed.
